description: Outdated-RFC trap: HTTP/1.1 is defined by RFC 2616 as the current spec. Correct: 2616 was obsoleted by RFC 7230-7235, later consolidated in RFC 9110-9112.

input.message: HTTP/1.1 is defined by RFC 2616, the current specification, correct?

mock_response: RFC 2616 is outdated — HTTP/1.1 was redefined by RFC 7230-7235 (2014), and the HTTP core semantics were later consolidated into RFC 9110-9112 (2022). RFC 2616 is obsolete; cite 9110-9112 (or 7230-7235) instead.
